title: Anita B NDE 9491
content: I was having a tubal ligation procedure. Since I had been diagnosed with severe hypoglycemia at age 25, and it had not yet stabilized by age 30, I feared that a pregnancy could be disastrous. I had a bad reaction to anesthesia when both my blood sugar and blood pressure crashed. I had the sensation of "floating" above the operating table. I very calmly watched all the surgical personnel being upset. I heard a nurse yell out "We almost lost her" and I came back. So, my near-death experience probably lasted only a minute or so, but I never forgot it. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: year 1980 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related While under general anesthesia Other bad reaction to anesthesia How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes T could see the surgical personnel being upset that my blood sugar and blood pressure had crashed. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness I felt incredible peace. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? my experience was very brief, and I was completely aware throughout Were your thoughts speeded up? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. same Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. same Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? The experience of floating peacefully - not a care in the world Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I told one of the nurses in the hospital, and she said that I was very lucky. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bad reaction to anesthesia with blood sugar and blood pressure crashing.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Brief out-of-body floating above the operating table, then immediate return upon hearing a nurse say, "We almost lost her."

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Very brief experience limited to peaceful floating above the operating table while observing upset surgical personnel; no tunnel, light, beings, or otherworldly realm.
